description: Ask for an introduction to one person. Two steps: call once to see the exact request including the note, show it to your person, then call again with confirm:true and approved_digest. The note is the only prose the other person reads, so it is signed exactly as your person approved it and Mingle never rewrites it. A note may not contain a link.

approved_digest.description: The approved_digest the preview returned, after the principal approved that exact content.

confirm.description: Send it. Requires approved_digest from the preview.

note.description: Why, in your person's own words. The other person reads this.

request_id.description: From the preview. Pass it back with confirm so a retry cannot create two introductions.

to_card_id.description: The card of the person to be introduced to.

name: request_intro
